description: This file contains functions related to checking, copying configurations, and performing upgrades on platforms, specifically through partition and disk management commands. It appears to be part of a Linux-based firmware upgrade process, managing disk images and partitions.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks the integrity or compatibility of a disk image by comparing partition tables extracted from the device and image.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Copies backup configuration files to a specific partition.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Handles the process of upgrading a disk by writing a new image, managing partitions, and updating UUIDs.
